config.experiment: Synthetic illustration of baseline, automatic and agent-triggered reranking

conditions.retrieval_policy: Synthetic shared difficulty; no retrieval executed
conditions.concurrency: Synthetic per-question elapsed time; not throughput
conditions.stopping_rule: Illustrative 240-second time limit; incomplete final answers score zero
conditions.run_selection: One synthetic observation per question/method; RNG seed 20261116

missing_cost_audit.pairing: strict question-ID pairing within benchmark, validated by shared loader
missing_cost_audit.aggregation: one benchmark and subset per estimate; All overlaps its subsets
missing_cost_audit.effect: candidate score minus baseline score, multiplied by score.scale

note: Paired-question percentile bootstrap (3,000 draws); intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted. All includes its subsets; benchmarks are never pooled.
